summary: Kjell Måsøval has rejoined BioMar in an executive position. title: Kjell Måsøval er tilbake i Biomar

summary: BioMar is expanding its research and development efforts in salmon aquaculture through twelve new research projects presented at ATC Patagonia. The initiative demonstrates the company's investment in advancing salmon farming science and technology in the region's aquaculture sector at a sector conference in Patagonia, Chile territory. The company is actively participating in industry innovation discussions focused on salmon productivity and sustainability improvements in the region's aquaculture sector.
title: ATC Patagonia: Biomar profundiza en I+D con 12 proyectos de investigación en salmónidos
